maya (People Ops): Heads-up: a small set of policy tweaks hitting in two weeks. Please skim 40s and save links.
maya (People Ops): Changes: 1) PTO carryover indexing (auto-link to local inflation) 2) consolidated mental-health day bucket 3) new international medical-evac approval workflow.
liam (Benefits): Quick explainer: carryover indexing means unused wellness/PTO days that carry into next year will now be adjusted by a small index for cost-of-living in certain regions. This is to keep parity across regions where local statutory holidays differ.
arjun (eng): Does indexing change the numeric carryover cap? For ex: I have a 5-day carry cap.
liam (Benefits): No  caps unchanged. Indexing modifies the equivalent local value when converting company-observed days to local days. Example: if your cap is 5 days and the local index factor is 1.2, you'll see a local equivalent up to 6 days for scheduling purposes only — your account still shows 5 days. We'll add a calculator.
sara (ops): Why now?
maya (People Ops): We've heard regional fairness concerns during relocations and transfers. Indexing reduces friction when people move regions mid-year. Implementation is opt-in for relocating employees for the first 3 months, then defaulted company-wide after feedback.
arjun (eng): Opt-in flow?
liam (Benefits): If you're relocating, HR will present the option during the location change flow in Workday. You can opt-in to indexed carryover for that payroll year. For others, no change until after the pilot window.
travel-bot: Medical-evac workflow updated  emergency med-evac requires pre-trip approval for travel to Level 2+ advisories if company-provided insurance is used: https://intranet.redwood/med-evac
maya (People Ops): New workflow (short): 1) pre-approval request via Travel Quick Approvals 2) Security reviews coverage 3) Benefits signs off on insurer coordination. Use form: https://forms.redwood/med-evac-request
arjun (eng): What if it's an actual emergency and I need evac now?
travel-bot: Emergency path: call +1-800-RED-SEC (24/7) and file the evac case after the fact. We'll fast-track claims submitted within 72 hours of the incident.
liam (Benefits): A note on taxes: indexed carryover conversion does not affect payroll tax status. Any cash conversions or top-ups remain payroll-reported (code: TOP-UP-23).
payroll-bot: Payroll code for indexed carryover adjustments: IDX-CARRY-26. Expect a one-off audit line for year-of-move adjustments.
sara (ops): Consolidated mental-health days?
maya (People Ops): We're merging "wellness days" and "mental health float" into a single 6-day bank for simplicity (effective next plan year). Remaining balances auto-merged at rollover. This reduces confusion and makes booking simpler.
arjun (eng): Will managers see the merged bucket in Workday for approvals?
liam (Benefits): Yes  approvals unchanged, display will show "Wellness+Mental". We'll run a short manager training next week.
maya (People Ops): Timeline recap: announcement today, pilot & opt-in for relocations starts in 14 days, med-evac workflow live immediately (links above), full indexing rollout after 90 days pending feedback.
arjun (eng): Who to contact for appeals or urgent payroll adjustments?
maya (People Ops): Appeals: people-ops-appeals@redwood.com. Urgent payroll: payroll@redwood.com (cc your manager). For security or evacuation call the emergency line above.
liam (Benefits): FAQ & simple calculator (estimate your indexed carry days): https://intranet.redwood/idx-carry-calc
maya (People Ops): We'll host two 30-min drop-in sessions Wed 8am PT & Thu 4pm PT. Recording will be posted. Thanks all 40 if anything urgent ping @maya or @liam.
